title: M100 GPU thermal hotspot detection
query_text: Telemetry alerts flag a thermal issue in rack 3. Which node and GPU is overheating, and what should I do?

eval_criteria.gold_answer: Node r3n7 is the thermal hotspot. Its GPU3 (ipmi metric gpu3_core_temp) crosses the 84°C throttle threshold, having ramped up over the final part of the window, and is markedly hotter than its rack-3 peers r3n0–r3n6, which stay in the normal operating range. Node fans (fan0_0, fan1_0) ramp up in response. Recommended action: drain r3n7 (scontrol update nodename=r3n7 state=drain reason=thermal) and inspect the GPU3 cooling path.
